en_title: Resident Evil Executive Producer Says the Series' Story Could End 'In the Next 10 Years'
cn_title: 竹内润：《生化危机》或十年内完结
subtitle: 故事终有尽头
opus_summary: 竹内润表示，《生化危机》主线故事或在未来十年内完结，此前还会推出多部作品。他称，团队筹划《生化危机2》重制版时制定了十年品牌规划，今年已告一段落。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with Yahoo Japan , executive producer Jun Takeuchi outlined Capcom’s plans for its flagship horror franchise, revealing that its encompassing narrative has a definite conclusion — and that end could come shockingly soon.
paragraphs.cn: 执行制作人竹内润在接受雅虎日本采访时，介绍了卡普空对旗下招牌恐怖游戏系列《生化危机》的规划。他透露，系列整体故事有明确的结局，而且完结之日可能来得出人意料地快。

paragraphs.en: Takeuchi began by explaining how the team had expanded on Resident Evil’s overarching story with every game, saying that a ten-year strategy was crafted during the planning stages for Resident Evil 2 Remake .
paragraphs.cn: 竹内润首先解释，团队如何随着每部新作不断拓展《生化危机》的整体故事。他表示，团队在筹划《生化危机2》重制版时制定了一份十年战略。

paragraphs.en: “The series' story wasn't planned out from the beginning; it expanded with each new game. When we were planning RE:2 and creating a 10-year branding concept, this was the most challenging aspect. If you play through all of them, I think you'll realize the meaning behind the order of the remakes,” he said.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「系列故事并非一开始就规划好了，而是随着每部新作不断拓展。我们在筹划《生化危机2》重制版、构思十年品牌规划时，这一点最具挑战性。如果大家把这些作品都玩一遍，我想就会明白重制版推出顺序背后的含义。」

paragraphs.en: “With the release of Requiem this year, I feel like the first 10 years have come to a close, so I think the conclusion will come in the next 10 years."
paragraphs.cn: 「随着《生化危机：安魂曲》在今年发售，我觉得第一个十年已经告一段落，所以我认为，故事会在接下来的十年里迎来结局。」

paragraphs.en: This is somewhat sad news for hardcore fans who were hoping to blast through hordes of zombies with Leon until the end of time, not to mention fans of all the other characters we’ve come to know and love over the years. And who’s to say if that means we won’t see these characters again in a new, different story?
paragraphs.cn: 对于那些希望永远跟着里昂扫荡尸潮的铁杆粉丝来说，这多少有些令人难过，更不用说喜爱其他角色的粉丝了——这些角色都是我们多年来逐渐熟悉并爱上的。不过，谁又能断言，这就意味着我们不会在一个全新的、不同的故事中再次见到这些角色呢？

paragraphs.en: As for how many Resident Evil games we can expect from Capcom in the interim, Takeuchi assured us that there will be several, though he didn’t describe any of them in depth.
paragraphs.cn: 至于在故事完结前，卡普空还会推出多少部《生化危机》游戏，竹内润明确表示会有多部，但没有深入介绍其中任何一部。

paragraphs.en: "I can't say, because it would spoil the fun for everyone, but there won't be just one. There will be multiple titles,” he said.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我不能透露，否则会破坏大家的乐趣，但不会只有一部，而是会有多部作品。」

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil has proven to be a massive hit for Capcom, particularly after RE7: Biohazard shocked life back into the series. Resident Evil 2 Remake is the best-selling game in the franchise, and its most recent addition, Resident Evil Requiem, passed $500 million in revenue after releasing earlier this year, becoming a driving factor in console sales within Japan.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》系列为卡普空取得了巨大成功，尤其是《生化危机7》以惊悚体验让系列重焕生机之后。《生化危机2》重制版是系列销量最高的作品，而最新作《生化危机：安魂曲》在今年早些时候发售后，收入已突破5亿美元(约合人民币33亿元)，并成为推动日本主机销量的因素之一。

paragraphs.en: Adding to this, Resident Evil 2 Remake was one of the top ten best-selling titles for Capcom in the first half of its 2027 fiscal year, with RE7 not far behind. Resident Evil 4 was also on that list, as was RE3 and Requiem — meaning that half of the company's top sellers in this period were in the Resident Evil franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，《生化危机2》重制版跻身卡普空2027财年上半年销量前十，《生化危机7》紧随其后。《生化危机4》《生化危机3》和《生化危机：安魂曲》也都榜上有名，也就是说，卡普空这一时期销量前十的作品中，有一半来自《生化危机》系列。

paragraphs.en: There’s lots for Resi fans to look forward to in the coming months; the Code Veronica remake launches early next year, and screenwriter Haris Orkin basically leaked a story mode DLC for Requiem that’s supposed to involve Spencer in some way. There’s also Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil movie to consider, which was met with rave reviews and a hit at the box office — though it's unlikely Cregger ever makes a sequel , even though he already has plans for what he’d do next .
paragraphs.cn: 未来几个月，《生化危机》粉丝还有不少值得期待的内容：《生化危机：代号维罗妮卡》重制版将于明年年初发售，编剧Haris Orkin也基本上泄露了《生化危机：安魂曲》的一部剧情模式DLC，据称其中会以某种方式涉及斯宾塞。此外，Zach Cregger执导的《生化危机》电影也值得一提，该片收获了热烈好评，票房表现也很出色。不过，尽管Cregger已经构思好接下来要拍什么，他仍不太可能拍摄续集。
